column1: # CI fails when a count RISES or a new pair appears.
# Lower a number as you fix; never raise one.
# ⛔ hubCheck GTR109 is WAIVED DELIBERATELY, and the rule is right in general.
# GTR109 prefers detect_errors="aggressive" because exit_code fails only on a non-zero exit.
# hubCheck is a VALIDATOR: its report is copied to stderr so the diagnosis is visible, and a
# passing report plausibly contains a summary line like "0 errors found". Under aggressive that
# text would fail a HEALTHY hub. The exit status is the verdict for a validator, so exit_code is
# the stronger check here, not the weaker one. Previously this file declared aggressive while
# redirecting both streams into the report dataset, so there was no text to scan at all.
